title: Simple, Safe, Same: Lung Ultrasound for COVID-19
brief_summary: Growing evidences are showing the usefulness of lung ultrasound in patients with COVID-19. Sars-CoV-2 has now spread in almost every country in the world. In this study, the investigators share their experience and propose a standardized approach in order to optimize the use of lung ultrasound in covid-19 patients. The investigators focus on equipment, procedure, classification and data-sharing.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* suspected COVID-19 patients,
* known COVID-19 patients.

Exclusion Criteria:

* confirmed disease different from COVID-19.
